segments.text: Kia crammed a 120 PS turbo into a sub-four-metre SUV. Wait... how?!
That little 1.0 turbo fires 172 Nm through a slick 7-speed DCT — genuinely quick.
And it's properly loaded — sunroof, ventilated seats, even ADAS — from just ₹7.40 lakh.
A turbo automatic Kia for under eight lakh? Somewhere, a Nexon just started sweating.
Sonet or Nexon — which one wins? Comment 1 or 2! And like, share, subscribe.
